scientific_principles: Cities and districts are territorial references, never substitutes for hydrologic boundaries.
Where a territorial corridor crosses more than one basin or river system, components remain separate until independently resolved.
El Niño association motivates historical reconstruction but does not create an event label without dated local evidence.
Current critical points, fajas marginales, defenses or projects are context; they are not historical event footprints or hydraulic capacity.
No absence of report is a verified negative control.
No provider discharge, design flow or current intervention value becomes an IRFEN threshold.
Map publication requires reproducible geometry; no approximate point or invented polygon may fill a geometry gap.
